description: This file defines the BuzzPhoto entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing photo attachments related to Buzz posts in the system. It includes ORM mappings, constants for image validation, and getter/setter methods for photo metadata and content.

classes.name: BuzzPhoto
classes.description: Entity class representing a photo associated with a Buzz post, including image metadata and Blob storage for the image data.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the photo.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the photo.

methods.name: getPost
methods.description: Returns the BuzzPost associated with this photo.

methods.name: setPost
methods.description: Associates a BuzzPost with this photo.

methods.name: getPhoto
methods.description: Retrieves the photo binary data or resource.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the photo.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the photo.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the photo.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the photo.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size metadata of the photo.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size metadata of the photo.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the photo.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the photo.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the photo.

methods.name: setHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the photo.
